### New in 1.5.9
- **Shelf Music CD (Compact Disc 💿)**:
  - Add a retro CD object to your shelves from the **Decorate this shelf** menu in Library.
  - **Upload MP3 Songs**: Tap the CD in Library to upload your favourite MP3 audio track directly into the CD.
  - **Play on Home**: Tap the CD on your Home shelf to play your uploaded song — the CD rotates continuously while playing, complete with animated floating musical notes! Tap again to pause/stop playback.
  - **One CD per Shelf**: Exactly one CD with one song per shelf.
  - **Permanent Deletion**: Tearing off or removing the CD permanently deletes the uploaded MP3 file from storage, freeing space to add a new CD with a new song.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps all your data.
